Limited","description":"Centaur Technologies Limited is a British Owned and managed specialist roofing company, focused on the development and supply of leading edge liquid roofing systems. Centaur Technologies possess a wealth of knowledge and expertise dedicated to delivering complete roofing solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations from survey, specification and analysis through to final installation.
Our continued investment in research and development means we are able to deliver increasingly rigorous product performance characteristics, incorporating ever stringent design requirements. We understand that comprehensive customer support is essential in ensuring that the correct product is specified and that the project is completed successfully on time.
When specified by ourselves and installed by a Centaur Quality Partnership Contractor, all systems are available with a comprehensive 10,15,20 and 25 year Centaur Partnership Guarantee covering both materials and workmanship.
Our Heritage

Although a relatively new venture Centaur Technologies embodies a technical heritage going back over four decades. Many of the people involved were the pioneers of liquid roofing systems into both UK and overseas markets. They developed the first moisture triggered polyurethane and led research and development of liquid roofing products throughout the 80’s, 90’s and up to the present date.
